name: Gucchi Matar
steps: Soak dried morels in 300 ml warm water for 20 minutes. Lift out, split large caps and rinse carefully to remove grit; strain and reserve the soaking liquid.
Heat ghee in a heavy pan. Cook onion 7 minutes until golden, then add ginger for 1 minute. Add tomato puree, coriander powder, chili and salt; cook 8 minutes until thick.
Whisk yogurt with a spoonful of warm masala, lower the heat and stir it into the pan. Add cleaned morels and 200 ml strained soaking liquid; cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Add peas and simmer 7–8 minutes until peas are tender and morels are soft but still springy. Add a little remaining soaking liquid if gravy becomes too thick.
Stir in garam masala, taste the salt and finish with coriander leaves. Serve warm with basmati rice so the morel aroma remains prominent.
tips: Gucchi are true honeycomb morels, not ordinary button mushrooms; wash away every grain of grit.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
